summary_oneline: Add a parrot-native GoogleDriveFileManager (FileManagerInterface over Drive v3 via GoogleClient/aiogoogle) as a sibling of FEAT-603's Graph managers, registered as manager_type="gdrive" and exposed through FileManagerToolkit plus a Google Drive toolkit.

precedent for promoting a get_*_client() config dict into a live per-service wrapper (FEAT-453)
auth-mode branch table (service_account / user / cached) the manager's connect() must reproduce, analogue of O365Tool._get_client in FEAT-603
the contract to implement: 9 abstract coroutines, 4 optional folder/rename hooks, find_files default
upstream Google-credential manager; fixes manager_name '<x>file', prefix and setup()/handle_file conventions (not reusable as base: bucket model, sync SDK)

reference surface to mirror (lifecycle, extensions list_entries/find_entries/upload_file_from_bytes/create_sharing_link/upload_files/download_files, 413 serving guard); Microsoft-specific, so Drive is a sibling class
backend-neutral batch result models to reuse unchanged
registration edit site #1 (lazy re-export so no SDK loads at import)
registration edit sites #3-#6 (literal, factory map, drive-relative path sets on tool + toolkit); find/batch ops already generic

default credential file the manager falls back to
media transport for Drive files.create/update/get(alt=media); resumable branch only partially wired

constraints.statement: FEAT-603 is not merged into dev: graph.py, batch.py, the _PARROT_NATIVE map and the widened ManagerType exist only on branch feat-FEAT-603-sharepoint-filemanager (dirty, review in flight).
constraints.implication: FEAT-608 must be sequenced after FEAT-603 lands on dev (its worktree must be cut from a dev that contains FEAT-603); spec §6 anchors must be re-verified then.

constraints.statement: GraphDriveFileManager is Microsoft-Graph-specific end to end (msgraph builders, @odata.nextLink, createLink, Graph host allow-list).
constraints.implication: GoogleDriveFileManager subclasses FileManagerInterface directly (sibling, not subclass) and re-implements the same extension surface; only batch.py is shared.

constraints.statement: DriveEntry and GraphFileManagerError live inside graph.py, which imports msgraph.
constraints.implication: Either relocate DriveEntry to a backend-neutral module (graph.py re-exports it) or define a Drive-specific entry model; importing graph.py from gdrive.py is not acceptable (SDK leak).

constraints.statement: parrot.interfaces.google imports selenium, webdriver_manager, playwright and redis at module import and GoogleClient.__init__ eagerly creates an aioredis client.
constraints.implication: gdrive.py must be a lazy entry in both shims (no aiogoogle/selenium/redis in sys.modules after `import parrot.interfaces.file`), and the manager must construct GoogleClient only in connect().

constraints.statement: GoogleClient.execute_api_call opens a new Aiogoogle session and re-runs discovery on every call.
constraints.implication: The manager needs one long-lived Aiogoogle session + discovered `drive` API per manager (a DriveClient wrapper like CalendarClient), otherwise listings, chunked uploads and batches pay discovery per call.

constraints.statement: The three Google auth modes are service_account / user (interactive) / cached, with per-mode branches already defined in GoogleBaseTool._get_client.
constraints.implication: connect() reproduces that table (AC3 analogue: one credential load per manager) and adopt_client() accepts an already-initialised GoogleClient from GoogleBaseTool.

constraints.statement: FileManagerInterface is path-addressed (list_files(path), upload_file(src, destination)) while the Drive API only addresses items by id and allows same-name siblings.
constraints.implication: A path→id resolver (segment walk over files.list with a per-manager cache) and an explicit conflict policy on upload/rename are required design elements.

constraints.statement: aiogoogle supports media upload/download through upload_file / pipe_from / download_file / pipe_to kwargs with aiofiles chunking; resumable uploads are modeled but only partially wired.
constraints.implication: Small uploads and streaming downloads come for free; large-file resumable sessions must be verified at spec time and may need a direct aiohttp resumable path (validated URL, no token in logs) as FEAT-603 did.

constraints.statement: FileManagerToolkit find/batch_upload/batch_download ops are already generic with a single-op fallback; _DRIVE_RELATIVE_BACKENDS gates the default_output_dir join.
constraints.implication: No toolkit operation changes; only the six registration edit sites plus optional native upload_files/download_files on the manager.

constraints.statement: No Drive tool, loader or integration exists; the Google tools that exist bypass GoogleClient (googleapiclient.discovery.build) and only GoogleCalendarToolkit/LyriaToolkit are toolkits.
constraints.implication: There is nothing to refactor (no M7/M8 analogue); a GoogleDriveToolkit is net-new and should follow GoogleCalendarToolkit's shape.

constraints.statement: aiogoogle is pinned ==5.17.0 inside the agents bundles while 5.19.0 is installed; no core extra covers Google Workspace.
constraints.implication: Add a `gdrive` extra (aiogoogle>=5.17,<6, aiofiles) included in `all`, mirroring the msgraph extra.

constraints.statement: TID251 forbids httpx/requests; aiogoogle's transport is aiohttp.
constraints.implication: aiogoogle is admissible; any direct HTTP (resumable upload URL) must use aiohttp with the same URL-validation discipline as AC21.

new.item: packages/ai-parrot/src/parrot/interfaces/file/gdrive.py — GoogleDriveFileManager(FileManagerInterface) + GoogleDriveFileManagerError; locator = root folder (id or path) and optional shared-drive id; auth kwargs credentials/auth_mode/scopes/user_creds_cache_file; extensions list_entries, find_files (server-side q=), upload_file_from_bytes, create_sharing_link, upload_files/download_files (BatchItemResult), setup()/handle_file with the 413 guard; manager_name "gdrivefile"
DriveClient wrapper (one Aiogoogle session + discovered drive v3 API per manager) — either promoted from GoogleClient.get_drive_client() like CalendarClient, or private to gdrive.py

unknowns.question: Which Drive targets must v1 support: only the authenticated principal's My Drive, shared drives (driveId + supportsAllDrives), and/or domain-wide delegation (service account impersonating a user via `subject`)?
plausible_answers: My Drive of the principal only (simplest; SA uploads may hit quota limits)
My Drive + shared drives via an optional shared_drive_id (recommended)

unknowns.question: How should paths map onto Drive's id-addressed model with duplicate names allowed?
plausible_answers: Path-based like S3/Graph: segment resolver + cache, first match, upload conflict_behavior replace|fail|rename (recommended)
Id-based only: keys are Drive file ids, root is a folder id
Hybrid: paths by default, `id:<fileId>` accepted anywhere a path is

unknowns.question: What should get_file_url() return by default on Drive?
plausible_answers: webViewLink without touching permissions (only viewers with existing access can open it)
create a `domain` reader permission then webViewLink (organization-wide, mirrors FEAT-603 default)
create an `anyone` reader permission (public link) — riskiest

unknowns.question: Which agent-facing surface is in scope?
plausible_answers: Also a GoogleDriveToolkit under parrot_tools.google (list/search/download/upload/share) like GoogleCalendarToolkit (recommended)
Also Workspace export (Docs/Sheets/Slides → PDF/DOCX/XLSX via files.export) in the toolkit

unknowns.question: Should GoogleClient.get_drive_client() be promoted to return a live DriveClient (hard cut of the config-dict return, as FEAT-453 did for Calendar)?
plausible_answers: Yes — promote (no callers exist; keeps one Aiogoogle session per manager) [default assumed]
No — keep the dict; put the wrapper privately in gdrive.py
